The remedy requires distinguishing the semantic from the pragmatic analysis of language, and the new definition it yields will both cover Frankfurt's own examples and explain our tolerance of bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: A Definition of Bullshit—New and Improved!
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Reisch offers the Intelligent Design movement as a paradigm of bullshit Frankfurt could not have used in the 1980s: like advertisers and politicians, ID urgently needs public approval ('teach the controversy') and is trying to get away with something. He traces ID's descent from constitutionally defeated creation science through Philip Johnson's Darwin on Trial, showing how Johnson speaks of evidence and naturalism to scientists while telling evangelical audiences that the real enemy is cultural modernism's tolerance of promiscuity and atheism. Judge Jones's Kitzmiller ruling that ID is 'a mere re-labeling of creationism' confirms what the bullshit was covering.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Truth in Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: If ID is bullshit, Reisch argues, Frankfurt's definition fails, because Johnson and his followers are not indifferent to truth; they are devoted to other, rotten truths about modernism and even to elevating regard for truth in the culture. Frankfurt's error was writing of 'the truth' as a single unitary thing everyone but the bullshitter agrees on, when our beliefs about how things really are are diverse and contradictory. Bullshitters conceal a commitment to other truths and an agenda inspired by them, since revealing those truths would be embarrassing, unpersuasive, or, as with ID, unconstitutional.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Truth about Semantics
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Even Frankfurt's bull-session example (with its Animal House atom-of-a-fingernail bit) shows relaxed talk serving other truths: self-image, reputation, and whether the apple of one's eye is impressed. Detergent slogans and politicians' rolled-up sleeves likewise run two conversations at once, one overt (clean clothes, policy) and one concealed (self-image, likeability), each resting on truths the bullshitter takes quite seriously. Reisch's definition follows: bullshit is the orchestration of at least two engagements between bullshitter and bullshitee, one concealed within or downplayed alongside the other, so indifference to truth is absent or only partly in play.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Solving Frankfurt’s Puzzle, or, Baseball, Hot Dogs, Apple Pie, and Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Reisch explains Frankfurt's blind spot through the historical neglect of pragmatics: even Carnap took for granted that any complete theory of language must include how language is used in context, yet analytic philosophy came to favor semantics, as the Cambridge Dictionary's twenty-six semantics entries against seven pragmatic ones attest. Since bullshit's essence lies in using speech to hidden purposes, it is an essentially pragmatic, not semantic, phenomenon, which also shows the Frankfurt-Cohen debate (truth versus meaning) is narrow. From the recipient's side, bullshit works best when its two coordinated concerns seem maximally unconnected, as when a science-education advocate turns out to be an evangelical in disguise.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Case for Purism about Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The pragmatic definition dissolves Frankfurt's puzzle: the liar sins against the semantics of truth, while the bullshitter sins against pragmatics, disguising the effect his speech is designed to have (advancing science education) behind another (promoting evangelical Christianity). We can safely ignore bullshit, as with the coworker's Darwin rants, because without a gullible audience it has no effect, unlike the lie about whether the office milk has soured. Reisch adds that Stephen Meyer's post-Kitzmiller defiance, Willy Loman's optimism, the robber in Dog Day Afternoon, and Mamet's Glengary Glen Ross salesmen show why we even sympathize with bullshitters clinging to their creations, and that our tolerance extends to the pluralism of beliefs bullshit exploits.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 4 - Bullshit and the Foibles of the Human Mind, or What the Masters of
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Reisch concludes that on the pragmatic definition there is less bullshit than 'Bullshit!'-slinging suggests: your partner announcing the relationship is over and a White House claim about an oil-rich nation eager for democracy are merely true or false announcements, not bullshit. Real bullshit is the partner engineering a blame-free breakup through talk of feeling smothered, or the claim that a dictator possesses nuclear weapons about to be used. He closes by comparing bullshit to a poem or symphony: a specific, artfully layered creation intelligently designed for pragmatic effect, which our casual use of the word obscures to the bullshitter's advantage.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Some Cognitive Foibles of the Human Mind
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Kenneth Taylor opens his essay on the debased stew of bullshit, propaganda, and spin in public discourse, arguing that in an open public square the bullshitting arts must become highly refined, whereas a totalitarian state can afford crude bludgeoning, and that the marketplace of ideas has not spontaneously driven out bad discourse. His central claim: purveyors cannot sell what we do not buy, so the fault lies partly in ourselves, in built-in architectural foibles of the mind that make it permanently susceptible to manipulation. bullshit works best when we do not recognize it, and susceptibility to comforting falsehood is rooted in the mind's very architecture.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Reclaiming the Public Square
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Taylor illustrates the mind's foibles with the Iraq war beliefs that held a vice-grip on believers long after disconfirming evidence, explained by confirmation bias and information cocoons like Fox News and talk radio. He walks through the classic framing experiments, the avian-flu programs that are identical when described as '2,000 saved' or '4,000 die,' showing how politicians Smith and Jones exploit framing to jointly mislead voters, and the Wason selection task, where subjects fail on abstract cards but succeed when reframed as bartender cheater-detection. Citing Stephen Pinker on evolved, domain-specific modules, he concludes that whoever controls the frame may control all, which is exactly the leverage the masters of the dark arts exploit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 5 - Bullshit and Personality
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Taylor draws the hopeful and bleak conclusions: our minds are fine instruments for hunter-gatherer information environments, but the modern mismatch between savannah-designed cognition and deliberately framed misinformation explains why bull, spin, and propaganda abound. The masters of the dark arts are now astute students of cognitive foibles and wield means of persuasion with unprecedented reach. His two-front response is education that instills suspicion of comforting falsehoods and the habit of re-framing, plus widening access to the means of public representation now monopolized by a self-serving elite, because 'only those who seek more than bullshit can drive it out.'

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Does the Bullshitter Pay Attention to the Truth
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Sara Bernal distinguishes public, interpersonal, and private bullshit (bullshitting oneself) and argues that in an era rich in public bullshit like the Iraq war, private bullshit should not be overlooked, since it is at the core of personality disorders. Departing rapidly from Frankfurt, she rejects his claim that bullshit is essentially unconnected to a concern with truth, proposing instead that core cases of bullshit have a stronger connection to truth than Frankfurt allows. Applying her revised analysis to personality disorders will, she claims, explain why their core features produce social difficulties.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Two Modes of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Against Frankfurt's picture of the bullshitter who pays no attention to truth at all, Bernal argues the typical bullshitter is strongly connected to truth via a desire to obscure a specific part of it, conscious or not. Her prototype is the undergraduate who, knowing she has nothing thoughtful to say on an assigned essay, throws up a screen of verbiage, sometimes with malice aforethought, sometimes through a barely conscious motive to get an undeserved A. Unlike the liar she never denies the hidden truth directly but works indirectly, through pompous tone, reluctance to get to the point, and windiness, or simply by distracting the audience.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit and Personality Disorders
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Bernal gives the Bush administration's yellowcake-from-Niger and Saddam-9/11 red herrings as distraction bullshit concealing the antecedent intention to invade Iraq, then states five features of her two-part conception: the bullshitter must attend to the one 'target' truth she wants to hide, bullshit shades into lying as awareness increases, unconscious motives do the work, non-verbal means suffice (the Newport ads), and self-bullshitting is a species of self-deception. Split-brain patients who confabulate 'that funny machine' to explain unaccountable giggling at a picture shown only to the right hemisphere ground the claim that unconscious motives are respectable neuroscience. Her account, unlike Frankfurt's, applies in psychiatry.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Some Examples of Bullshit in Personality Disorders
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The essay defines personality disorder via DSM-IV as an enduring, inflexible pattern deviating from cultural expectations, and catalogs the ten disorders in three clusters: the erratic (antisocial, with the Enron crew and glib con artists as textbook cases; borderline; histrionic, from the undergrad who visits professors' office hours to talk about herself; narcissistic), the anxious (avoidant, dependent, obsessive-compulsive), and the eccentric (schizoid, schizotypal, paranoid). The clue to where bullshit lurks: wherever the afflicted is out of touch with some key aspect of reality or where her stock behavior leads others to false beliefs. The disorders' rigidity makes life 'a bad one-act play that repeats again and again.'

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit and Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The essay works through the disorders case by case: the antisocial's glib charm implicates 'I am not a nasty piece of work' without saying it, the borderline's suicidal gestures implicate 'life without you is not worth living' that her contempt belies, the histrionic's shallow opinions and sexual provocativeness implant false impressions of depth, and the compensating narcissist's charade of superiority hides a dimly glimpsed core of low self-esteem. Self-directed bullshit follows: the fanatic paranoid's superhero fantasies deny that she is not extraordinary, the phobic avoidant displaces anxiety onto elevators and dogs, the self-deserting avoidant escapes into fantasy, dependents distract themselves from doubts about their caregiver, and the obsessive-compulsive buries big-picture anxiety in rules and lists.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Perfect Partners Bullshit and Distorted Social Perceptions
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Surveying the catalog, the essay finds bullshit strategems that are first-rank symptoms in eight of ten disorders, quoting Frankfurt's 'each of us contributes his share' to observe that pathological personalities are notably generous contributors. Bullshitting is notably absent from the eccentric cluster: the schizoid's flat affect removes the pain-avoidance motive, and schizoids and schizotypals lack the mindreading facility successful bullshit requires. Other-bullshitting (mostly falsehood-implicating) marks the erratic cluster, self-bullshitting (mostly distraction) the anxious, and the essay closes by stressing that the disordered person is afflicted, her bullshit a personal tragedy as well as an infliction.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Threat Posed by Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The essay's final section argues distorted social perception and bullshit are perfect partners that reinforce each other: the paranoiac imagining insults, the histrionic inhabiting a world of admirers, and the borderline seeing abandonment everywhere each see less of social reality, supplying more 'easy targets' to obscure without the sting of conscience that aware deception provokes. The compensating narcissist's glimmering of her charade and the self-deserting avoidant's glimmering of her escape show how dim awareness eases bullshitting. The street runs both ways, since hiding parts of social truth from yourself further impairs your perception, so some disorder bullshit is causally downstream of distortion while self-bullshitting deepens it.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 6 - Performing Bullshit and the Post-Sincere Condition
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Concluding an essay on personality disorders, this chapter argues that pathological personalities (the antisocial, borderline, dependent, paranoiac) are especially good bullshitters and that their bullshit and distorted perceptions are what wreck their social relationships, since good relationships thrive on truth as much as on truthfulness. Against Frankfurt's claim that bullshit is the greater enemy of truth because indulging it erodes attention to reality, the author counters that the bullshitter does track truth at some level; bullshit's distinctive danger is that, unlike lying, it can be unconscious, so the sting of conscience never checks the habit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Shitty Attitudes On the Use and Misuse of Bullshit in Life
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: This mini-essay opens by parodying a puffing university mission statement, aspiring to be 'one of the world's best philosophy essays' in the UBC mold. It then sets the agenda: Frankfurt left unanswered why our attitude toward bullshit is generally more benign than our attitude toward lying, and never considered bullshit's rhetorical uses and misuses - the two gaps the rest of the essay fills.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit as a Condition of Life
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Reworking Frankfurt's Fania Pascal anecdote (Wittgenstein's disgusted 'You don't know what a dog that has been run over feels like'), the chapter argues that the bullshit that earns the retort 'That's bullshit!' is speech whose truth is irrelevant and which aims to evoke a positive attitude toward the speaker - hypochondriac pain complaints, boilerplate about graduate training in grant proposals, praise of the Dean to pass a hiring motion. It separates this from bullshit-as-entertainment and from courtesy conventions like thanking the gift-giving aunt, concluding against Frankfurt that pretentiousness is constitutive of at least this central kind of bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The World as Will to Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: This section answers Frankfurt's exercise about benignity: bullshit is 'dishonesty without tears' because whole genres - grant proposals, Fourth of July oratory, letters of reference - generically require performative values everyone knows count for nothing, like compulsory figures in figure skating. Rejecting free-riding as the origin of bullshit genres (bullshit letters get found out), it explains the reference letter instead by its multiple interested audiences: the writer must satisfy the student, the admissions committee, and her own conscience at once, and only the right dose of bullshit accomplishes that.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Overcoming Overwhelming Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter indicts an expanding class of 'performative bullshit': the video-store service pledge and the UBC mission statement, where a commitment is treated as fulfilled in the very act of being made, so no complaint can even be lodged. George W. Bush's fabricated WMD case for the Iraq war shows the political version - an argument counts as good simply because it was offered as the reason, and when the intelligence proved false another reason was fabricated. In such a world sincerity, irony, and even cynicism become impossible, since only pseudo-motives remain, lacking even sincere self-interest.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 7 - The Importance of Being Earnest A Pragmatic Approach to Bullshitting
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Closing the essay, this section argues the bullshit world is inherently stable rather than unstable: the administrator whose whole professional being is appending mission-talk to whatever the university already does is its emblem. The one live remedy is the Jon Stewart gambit - The Daily Show's openly fake news outperforming 'serious' sources, showing by self-consciously flouting the conventions of truth-telling what those conventions were for - and beyond that, actually taking a mission statement seriously enough to rethink higher education's values rather than settle, undeserving, for bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Two Tauroscatological Schools
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: De Waal's opening salvo: Frankfurt analyzed the concept of bullshit by ordinary language, but the interesting question is the intention with which bullshitting is produced. He announces a contrast between bullshitting and genuine inquiry, and blames bullshit's prevalence partly on a lost confidence that figuring out how things really are is possible or worthwhile.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Epistemic Imperative
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Building on G.A. Cohen's split of bullshit thinking into a structuralist school (bullshit is an intrinsic feature of products, e.g. texts unclarifiably unclear whatever the author intended) and an intentionalist school (Frankfurt: bullshit is the act done with indifference to truth), the chapter defends intentionalism against the 'insight problem'. The sham astrologer whose Tarot-based celebrity-death prediction happens to come true, and Perry's undergraduates who aced an exam they bullshitted, show that a claim stays bullshit until someone not bullshitting has affirmed it and thereby transformed it into knowledge - just as one person's trash is another's treasure without the chair itself changing.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Problem with Bullshitting
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Against the bullshitter the chapter recruits Peirce: genuine inquiry is defined not by method or results but by the attitude of truly wanting true answers, so homicide detectives, philologists, and car mechanics all count as scientists in this sense. Bullshitting is a free-rider riding the bus of real inquiry - even the bullshitter wants his doctor not to bullshit - and the chapter formulates an epistemic imperative: proceed on the hope that there is a true answer and act from the desire to find it, with fallibilism, not skepticism, the viable stance (the passenger who can occupy any vacant seat cannot occupy them all).

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: So Why Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Violations of the epistemic imperative are sorted into Peirce's 'sham reasoning' (the creationist who reasons only to prop up a fixed conclusion), Haack's 'fake reasoning' (corporate-funded research, vote-seeking politicians, the temporary-insanity plea), and the skeptic's premature 'we'll never know' - none of which is bullshitting, which is precisely not caring about truth, like the sales clerk praising shoes at random. Even philosophy can slide into bullshitting when, per Rorty, it becomes 'carrying on the conversation' with truth as what your peers let you get away with; and brainstorming differs from a bull session because brainstormers actually want to discover something.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: II - The Bull by the Horns
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Why do people bullshit? Because liberal democracy, heir to the Cartesian rejection of authority and the Enlightenment's think-for-yourself ideal, expects instant opinions on everything from people detached enough that nothing they say makes a difference; and because a failed search for certainty breeds prophylactic pessimism about inquiry itself. The cure is earnestness - scientists take colleagues' results on trust - though the chapter concedes defensible cases: the formulaic 'It's nice to see you!' as fake reasoning for civility, and friends horsing around for fun.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 2 Two Species of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Cohen's autobiographical preface: his youthful struggle with Althusserian French Marxism of the 1960s - interpellation, contradiction and overdetermination - taught him that writings attracting reverent attention can still be bullshit, a lesson sealed when his Marxist discussion group took the name Non-Bullshit Marxism Group, 'Marxism without the shit of the bull'. He also diagnoses the psychology (cognitive dissonance reduction plus adaptive preference formation) by which readers of rebarbative texts overvalue the banal sense they finally extract.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 3 Bullshit and Lying
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Via the OED's two entries, the chapter finds that 'bullshit' denotes two different things: nonsense or rubbish (output-centered - the shit wears the trousers) and insincere talk (producer-centered - the bull wears the trousers, Frankfurt's kind). Frankfurt's fault is not error but generality: he cast his account of one flower as the 'essence' of the whole garden, ignoring the academically more significant kind that is defined without any reference to a producer's state of mind.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 4 Bullshit as Unclarifiable Unclarity
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Cohen's main critique: Frankfurt identifies the liar by his goal (misleading about reality) but the bullshitter only at the level of tactic (indifference to the truth of what he says), leaving the bullshitter no distinctive goal - so advertisers and politicians, Frankfurt's own paradigm bullshitters, actually pursue the liar's goal and their bullshitting and lying coincide. Freud's favorite Pinsk/Minsk joke shows tactic and goal can come apart (deceiving by telling the truth), and the Fourth of July orator, contra Frankfurt, might care very much that the audience believe things about the Founding Fathers.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 5 Bullshit as Product and Bullshit as Process
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Cohen's positive account: bullshit is a feature of texts, paradigmatically 'unclarifiable unclarity' - discourse that cannot be rendered clear without ceasing to be a version of what was said, which is why the way to defend Hegel or Heidegger is to show their texts make sense, not that they cared about truth. A sufficient test is the negation sign: if adding or subtracting it makes no difference to plausibility, as with Sokal's hoax physics, the text is bullshit - though suggestively valuable poetry is spared. 'Bullshitter' then splits into a dispositional reading and an aim reading, only the latter of which always bullshits when producing bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 9 - The Unity of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Cohen concludes that because bullshit can be emitted innocently - even by honest acolytes - the Sokal-style struggle against academic bullshit must target the visible product rather than the producer's hidden intentions, lest innocent traffickers be slandered as insincere or deliberately obscure. Fun as it is to write 'bullshit' over and over in an academic article, the bullshitter/bullshit distinction matters because the justice of the polemic depends on it.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: No Bullshit, Please, We’re Austrian
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Hardcastle proposes to settle the Frankfurt-Cohen quarrel by adding logical positivism to the mix: the Vienna Circle's war on metaphysics was the 1920s-30s' great anti-bullshit program, and both Frankfurt's negligence-of-truth and Cohen's unclarifiable unclarity have precedents in it. Laura Penny's Your Call Is Important to Us supplies the moral heat ('when you fuck with English, you are money-changing in my temple'), while the summary of both positions - the liar needs the truth, the bullshitter does not give a hoot - sets up the Carnap chapters.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: A Little Carnap in Everyone
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Carnap's 'Overcoming Metaphysics through Logical Analysis of Language' supplies the unification: his verificationism renders the invented word 'teavy' meaningless for the same reason Cohen's texts are unclarifiably unclear, while Heidegger's 'The nothing noths' exemplifies the pseudo-sentence whose utterance expresses disregard for meaning - Frankfurt-style bullshitting. The 'toovy' example drives the point home: once a term's synonymy with 'quadrangular' is fixed, professing a further hidden meaning reveals a speaker who never intended to convey information at all.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Unity of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Meaning, for Carnap, is bearing the right deductive relations to other claims - exactly Cohen's insight that clarity is relational, so that 'clarifying' an unclarifiable text mangles it into something unrecognizable. Carnap's diagnosis of why metaphysics flourishes - metaphysicians express a general attitude toward life (Lebenseinstellung), better expressed through art, and mistake it for a state of affairs - explains bullshit's ubiquity and tolerance; but the metaphysician who knows he says nothing, like Heidegger after Carnap called him on it, is Frankfurt's bullshitter pure and simple.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 10 - Raising the Tone Definition, Bullshit, and the Definition of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The unification: Frankfurt's intentionalist bull and Cohen's structuralist shit are two sides of one thing, since a language amenable to misuse meets the bullshitter's ends halfway. The response is gun control for language - not Carnap's ideal language, but shared responsibility for English in our presence, from writing letters to casting votes - ending with Otto Neurath's anti-pseudorationalist insistence that the world's shape reflects our own choices rather than reasons beyond our control: it really is up to us.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: A Caricature History of Semantics
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter christens Frankfurt's innovation 'semantic negligence' on the legal model: the deceptive bullshitter has a duty of care to truth and breaches it without intending the resulting deception, which is why lying (intentional) is more culpable, yet bullshit more insidious because it degrades the commitment to truth on which public discourse depends. Terry Pratchett's characters who applaud 'any man who can tell an outrageous whopper with a gleam in his eye' mark the complicit bull session - bullshit deceives only when it escapes the session and masquerades as ordinary assertion.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Broadening the Analysis
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Stevenson's persuasive definition - changing a term's descriptive meaning while keeping its emotive force - is restated in Fregean terms as changing sense or reference while representing tone as fixed, yielding a sixteen-fold table of definitional moves (PD, PQD, and beyond). Semantic negligence then grades PDs: the aphoristic 'Conservatism is true socialism' deceives no one, but the definer who hides an argument inside a definition gains rhetorical advantage while risking that his audience endorses conclusions they were never given a fair chance to appraise - analogous to bullshit rather than lying.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit and Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Flew's No-True-Scotsman Move - retreating from 'No Scotsman takes sugar with his porridge' to 'No true Scotsman...' when Hamish MacTavish of Inverness falsifies it - is analyzed as a redefinition that converts a bold, falsifiable claim into a vacuous necessary truth. Because the two statements look and sound alike, confusing them (from carelessness as easily as deceit) is semantic negligence, and pressing on as if the original claim still stood is classic Frankfurt bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 11 - Different Kinds and Aspects of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Closing chapter 10's circle: Frankfurt's definition of 'bullshit' is itself a persuasive definition of case d - it changes the term's sense and reference while keeping the pejorative tone, as the well-meant 'Help is on its way' to the critically injured shows. Because Frankfurt argues explicitly for his departures from conventional usage, his definition is semantically diligent rather than negligent, though Cohen's complaint that it omits academic bullshit remains to be answered - with which Chapter 11 opens.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Harry Frankfurt on Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Maes and Schaubroeck open on the bookstore irony: Frankfurt's slim bestseller On Bullshit shelved beside Chakra Balancing Kit, The Hidden Messages in Water Crystals, and Astrology: A Cosmic Science - almost as if placed there to illustrate the very bullshit Frankfurt diagnosed as the most salient feature of our culture. They then introduce Cohen's admiring complaint that Frankfurt examined 'just one flower in the lush garden of bullshit', teeing up the academic kind Cohen will define.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: A Different Take on Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: A faithful reconstruction of Frankfurt: the bullshitter is a slovenly craftsman whose laxity concerns truth rather than detail - spin doctors control every tiny thing except whether what they say is true. The bull session shows indifference alone is not enough, since bullshit adds the pretence that hides that indifference (the Fourth of July orator misrepresents his own state of mind, not American history), whence Frankfurt's conclusion that bullshit is the greater enemy of truth - and the announcement that all three claims (unconcern, concealment, blameworthiness) will be contested.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: A Different Kind of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The Pascal anecdote returns to undermine Frankfurt: Wittgenstein's disgust at 'I feel just like a dog that has been run over' involves no fakery, so pretence is not an essential ingredient of bullshit - mere indifference to truth suffices, as the hypothetical politician who openly stops caring would show. Bullshit emerges as often benign: Ishiguro's butler Stevens in The Remains of the Day comes to see bantering as 'the key to human warmth', Nagel's polite 'How nice to see you!' is convention-governed and no deception, and Wilde's epigrams - nearly all bullshit - explain why our attitude toward bullshit is softer than toward lying.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: III - It’s All Around Us
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Cohen's product-based kind (unclarifiable unclarity, probed by the negation-sign test) is summarized, and the chapter asks whether Frankfurt-bullshit and Cohen-bullshit exhaust the lush garden. They do not: pseudoscience like astrology, chakra balancing, and bogus healing is a third, damaging kind - its practitioners sincerely believe (failing Frankfurt's indifference test) and predict specifically and clearly (failing Cohen's unclarity test) - so insensitivity to evidence and fallacious reasoning must be central to its analysis, better to be vaguely right than precisely wrong.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshitting and Lying in Politics
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Opening Mark Evans's Chapter 12: Frankfurt's claim that democracy especially breeds bullshit, since it charges every citizen with having opinions about everything - the 'Frankfurt thesis' that citizens do not care about truth. It is contrasted with the 'cynicism thesis' (citizens do not care about politics, out of well-founded disillusion with a system that fails to deliver), and both are framed by the objection as old as Plato that political understanding is an expertise we cannot all share - theses argued about, not against, democracy.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Myth of the ‘Well-Informed’ Citizen
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Mark Evans opens the book's political section by insisting that politicians mostly produce bullshit rather than lies in Frankfurt's strict sense: lying requires knowing and concealing the truth, while the Bush administration's WMD case for invading Iraq shows truth-indifference, with post-hoc 'rejustifications' (humanitarian intervention, democratisation, Saddam-9/11 hints) spun as needed. Using G.A. Cohen's distinction between aim-bullshitters and disposition-bullshitters, it reads Winston Smith's routinized rewriting of The Times in Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four as falsehood that slides from lying into bullshit, since the Party aims to destroy the very true/false distinction. Totalitarian regimes (Havel's 'living in truth') thus embed themselves not in a web of lies but in a morass of bullshit insulated from any possibly refuting facts.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: ‘Dumbing-Up’ Some Distortions of Democratic Equality
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Evans argues that democratic citizens do their own share of Frankfurt-bullshitting about politics: because electoral democracy cannot admit how complex politics really is, it institutionalizes the fictional ideal of the 'well-informed' citizen, obliging voters to hold over-simplified views and politicians to pander to them. Campaigning forces candidates into dodges like the 'politics of distraction' and the empty promise to be 'a different sort of politician', producing 'Governor Schwarzenegger Syndrome' and opening space for dangerous demagogues and fundamentalisms. Following Churchill, the chapter concludes that this citizen-side bullshit vindicates the cynicism thesis only partially and gives no reason to reject democracy as 'the worst form of government except for all the others'.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Philosophy versus Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter claims that 'equal respect' in modern democracies has been distorted into a 'dumbing-up' relativism — 'I'm valid, you're valid' — which conflates the equal right to voice opinions with their equal intellectual merit and so leaves nothing that counts as bullshit. It illustrates this through the 'democratization of expertise' and management-speak ('downsizing', 'mission statements'), which mimics profundity while evading awkward facts, and it tests and rejects the quasi-Nietzschean ressentiment story of timid citizens dragging discourse down to a common denominator. To get the full measure of the phenomenon it expands Frankfurt's and Cohen's typologies into seven kinds of bullshit, adding clarifiable unclarity, plain rubbish, irretrievable speculation, pretension, and evasion.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 13 - Political Bullshit and the Stoic Story of Self
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Evans concludes that the antidote to political bullshit is a discursive culture trained in Socratic skills of self-examination — citizens taught to recognize how their own views may be imperfect and how to refine them — together with the analytic-philosophical style his Oxford tutor called 'a very good bullshit detector'. Experts may lead debates by their greater factual knowledge and critical acumen, but the debates must stay democratically inclusive rather than become an elite monopoly. Citing G.A. Cohen, he warns that too much fashionable philosophy disparages truth and so itself produces bullshit, and that using the ubiquity of bullshit to justify the cynicism thesis's crippling inertia would be potentially catastrophic.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Stories Shape Our Feelings
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Vanessa Neumann sets out a third strategy for analyzing bullshit, beside Frankfurt's agent-centered and G.A. Cohen's content-centered definitions: studying the mechanism of bullshit, the speaker-listener relation through which it works in political discourse. Bullshit need not be false — even true statements can be non-germane or obfuscatory — and it serves two purposes: depicting the speaker as desirable ('I'm one of you') and targeting groups ('they are different from us, so we should treat them like this'). Its key trick is moral language without moral commitment, as when a politician condemns a rival's corporate free trip without explaining why it is wrong, scoring points while preserving wiggle room for future favors of their own.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 14 - Bullshit at the Interface of Science and Policy Global Warming,
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter dissects 'we are waging a war on terror' word by word: the inclusive 'we' conscripts the listener, 'war' triggers unquestioning patriotism, and 'terror' — an emotion, rather than 'terrorists' or 'terrorism' — keeps the enemy suitably vague, a bogeyman Other to hunt. The phrase is bullshit not because fighting terrorism is wrong but because it replaces the thought and debate that democratic policy and military decisions require with fear management, and militant jihadists' 'God's will' rhetoric works the same way, never explaining how bombing or torturing the uninvolved will end fear. Both sides use bullshit to supply identity and purpose while evading genuine moral justification, which degrades our capacity to be moved by ideas.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit of the Isolated Fact
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Heather Douglas opens her chapter on science advice by framing the problem with Plato's parable of the stargazer as expert navigator for the ship of state in the Republic, tracing the debate from excluding pseudoscience through 'junk science' to 'politicized science'. She identifies two kinds of bullshit at the science-policy interface: true-but-misleading statements that exploit technical complexity to confuse the public about uncertainty, and appeals to a nonexistent universal standard of 'sound science' that actually smuggle in judgments about the consequences of error. Remedies include constant vigilance and reframing debates around the explicit weighing of evidence, uncertainty, and the risks of getting things wrong.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit of Universal Standards
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter explains 'bullshit of the isolated fact' through the climate-change debate: skeptics like Robert Balling and Fred Singer repeatedly cited the 1940-1975 cooling trend as incompatible with human-caused warming while omitting the aerosol research — confirmed when models correctly predicted the cooling after Mt. Pinatubo's 1991 eruption — which shows sulfate scrubbing had been masking the greenhouse signal. Likewise the satellite-versus-ground temperature discrepancy, which skeptics took as disproof, dissolved once instrument errors were re-examined. Repeating an isolated fact after its debunking has been publicized in Science or National Academy reports is, with Frankfurt, to reveal oneself unconcerned with the truth — willing to spread bullshit to win.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Combatting the Two Kinds of Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Douglas argues that 'universal standards bullshit' — the assumption that evidence must meet one threshold before it counts as scientific — comes from textbook schooling and has no warrant: there is no such standard, and we shouldn't want one. She shows how it distorts debate on all sides, from Bush administration uncertainty claims to Michael Gough's Popper-inspired insistence that climate models cannot be tested, and argues that whether evidence suffices always depends on the risks of error — the gas-gauge warning versus the bomb in your car. Genuine politicization (suppressing evidence, firing researchers) must be condemned, but deciding how much uncertainty is acceptable is an ineliminably political and ethical judgment.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 15 - Rhetoric Is Not Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Douglas concludes that the two kinds of bullshit need different remedies. Isolated-fact bullshit — Fred Singer's commentaries resting on selective omission and emphasis — can only be met with vigilance, since the public forum must remain open and even its spreaders may not grasp the nature of their claims. Universal-standards bullshit, by contrast, can be permanently undermined once we recognize there are no such standards: asking instead about the strength of evidence and the risks of error, and getting used to expert disagreement, would deflate the persuasive power of a single isolated fact.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Problem (and Politics) of Rhetoric
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: David Tietge opens his defense of rhetoric with the aphorism that rhetoric isn't devious and untrustworthy — those are features reserved for language itself — and reports a semester-long count in which 156 of 157 media uses of 'rhetoric' were pejorative, the sole exception being George Carlin telling Jon Stewart that a comedian is essentially a rhetorician who unpacks how words mean. He traces rhetoric's decline from its honored place in the Trivium of the Seven Liberal Arts, notes the societal paradox that we condemn 'bullshit' yet richly reward lawyers, politicians, and advertising executives for producing it, and promises to dissolve the crude truth/falsity dichotomy that fuels the identification of rhetoric with bullshit.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Chapter 16 - Just Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Tietge argues that postmodernism, far from denying objective reality, supplies a vocabulary for how language and interpretation shape small-t truths, and that rhetoric — Kenneth Burke's 'logology', words used to talk about words — is the discipline uniquely built to study this; hence rhetoric and bullshit are 'not even distant cousins'. He concedes Frankfurt's 'talk without knowing what he is talking about' catches genuine bullshit, like the student paper opener 'In today's society, there are many things that people have different and similar opinions about', and allows that 'salesman syndrome' rhetoric can be bullshit when its pitch is too transparent to persuade anyone. His remedy is to learn rhetoric — through hypothetical situations, deconstructing model essays, and keeping a commonplace book — since navigating the gray area between Truth and bullshit without understanding how language works leaves us to avoid the pitfalls by sheer chance.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit as a Call to Open-Mindedness
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Steve Fuller opens by asking whether bullshit detection coarsens the detector: Nietzsche and H.L. Mencken embraced the debunker's role (Mencken coining 'bunk'), while Ibsen's The Wild Duck and Hedda Gabler dramatize the need for a 'life lie', and detectors who find bullshit everywhere slide from nihilism into dogmatism. He re-reads bullshit as sophistry — the Sophists taught that securing your audience's belief is the only knowledge you need, against Socrates's attack and Plato's coining of 'rhetoric' to demonize them — and faults Frankfurt for calling the bullshitter 'indifferent' to truth when the accomplished bullshitter must be a keen student of what people tend to regard as true. The Sokal affair and Benjamin Franklin's 'economical with the truth' lead to his Kantian mapping of bullshitters (rationalists selecting among already-imaginable alternatives) against bullshit detectors (empiricists demanding evidence), which the scientific method will dialectically synthesize.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Wittgenstein Ultimate Bullshit Detector—or Bullshitter
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Fuller argues that mastering a discipline converts critics into loyal insiders — Thomas Kuhn's 'normal science' enshrines the tendency, cognitive dissonance explains it, and Blaise Pascal's wager is the general model of betting on a way of life that makes you receptive to its confirming signs. Against this he sets the Protestant tradition of Luther's conscience, 'playing it by ear', which like the Sophists concedes that reality rarely yields yes-or-no answers — the gap we fill being bullshit — and he frames the dispute as realism versus antirealism, reading Frankfurt's On Bullshit as an ad hominem attack on antirealists. He then re-examines Frankfurt's star witness: Wittgenstein's rebuke of Fania Pascal for saying she felt 'like a dog that has been run over' now looks like a spectacular lack of imagination, since evolutionary psychology, being forged at that very moment, has been narrowing the human-animal mental gap ever since.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Bullshit as Deferred Epistemic Gratification
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter reverses Frankfurt's verdict: Wittgenstein may himself have been a grandmaster of bullshit who practiced 'ventriloquism', speaking through the authority of ordinary language and 'paradigm case' examples, and whose scolding of Fania Pascal strikes some readers today like a priest fussing over a parishioner's impure thoughts. His bullshit was backward-looking ('you already know this'), unlike the forward-looking promissory bullshit of Galileo, whose deferred vindication Paul Feyerabend used to argue that the Papal Inquisitors were originally justified in their skepticism. Ernest Gellner's ostracized diagnosis — that Wittgenstein fed off British class anxiety most clearly marked in language use — is resisted both because careers ride on his authority and because his erratic 'idiot savant' persona keeps bullshit from sticking to him.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Scientific Method as a Search for the Justice in Bullshit
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Fuller portrays the bullshitter as the consummate hypocrite, bluffing from behind genuine uncertainty and exploiting the sophistic principle that controlling the moment of decision controls its outcome — calling the question when the balance of arguments favors you. Since we can rarely audit anyone's track record, epistemology leans on 'trust', 'witness' and 'testimony', read optimistically through Thomas Reid's divinely guaranteed common sense or, à la Kierkegaard, malignly as cowardly delegation of belief; either way 'reliability', which papers over the gap between evidence and belief, is itself a bullshit concept. He then analogizes the epistemic economy of evidence to the moral economy of sensation: as utilitarianism defers immediate gratification (taxation insuring against discounting our future selves), so the bullshitter's imperviousness to current evidence-weightings is prudence — an 'affirmative action' for weaker-evidenced positions that may prove the better bet in the fullness of time.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 024 - Bullshit and Philosophy - Guaranteed to Get Perfect Results Every Time
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Our Distinguished Panel of Incomparable Geniuses
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Fuller's finale casts Francis Bacon's scientific method as an inquisitorial trial designed to manage bullshit: everyone may produce it, provided a third-party judge frames a 'crucial experiment' that decides between the parties — a vision only partially realized by the Royal Society and later positivism, and tempered by Karl Popper's open-society point that all may bullshit to their heart's content given agreement on how to clean up after it. He tests the model on the Lomborg affair (initially found 'scientifically dishonest', then acquitted on appeal because politicized research is the environmental norm), on Zola's J'Accuse and Galileo's vindication in Newton's Principia as productive bullshit, and on his own service as expert witness: McLean v. Arkansas cut through creationist and evolutionist bullshit with a neutral definition of science, while Kitzmiller v. Dover adopted a 'methodological naturalism' custom-built to exclude Intelligent Design — justice losing out to the side whose bullshit is piled higher and deeper.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 041 - Stephen Colbert and Philosophy - I Am Philosophy (And So Can You!)
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Wishing and Dogmatism
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Matthew Pierlott argues Colbert the satirist conflates two things his character, Stephen, merges: truthiness (trusting gut and heart over external authorities like dictionaries) and bullshit in Frankfurt's exact sense - speech indifferent to truth, which Pierlott finds in Hillary Clinton's dismissal of economists on the gas-tax holiday and likens to Steve Careill's habitual pleasantries versus Jon Stewart's honesty and Stephen's lies. He defends gut and heart as evidence-bearing tools - knowing a candidate's 'heart' from character evidence (the Westmoreland Ten Commandments interview), gut intuitions as unconsciously processed experience, and choosing which of the two Cheneys (1994 quagmire prophet or 2003 liberators booster) to trust - so in an information-saturated democracy truthiness is a necessary part of any orientation toward truth. The real enemy is dogmatism, the 'Dark Side of Truthiness' that cuts off future evidence, while wishful thinking kept modest (optimism that people are honest) can even be beneficial, a Jamesian willing-to-believe.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 100 - Batman, Superman, and Philosophy - Badass or Boyscout_
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 18. Superman the Super Dick
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Modeled on Harry Frankfurt's analysis of 'bullshit,' the chapter defines a 'dick' as someone who willfully disregards others' needs, and argues Superman qualifies: he lets crimes proceed while he works at the Daily Planet or hunts vending-machine change, although the SuperBat storyline (Superman/Batman #53-56) shows a briefly super-powered Batman clearing every city's crime in a single night. Applying Peter Singer's famine-and-affluence argument - the penny that saves a life, the ten-cent polio vaccine - the chapter contends that saving at little or no cost to oneself is obligatory rather than supererogatory, so Superman's convenience-first choices make him a 'Super Dick.' Batman, who risks his mortal life seeking out strangers to save, does what he can and therefore escapes the charge.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 140 - Avatar and Philosophy - Learning to See
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Trust and Truth
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Kellen builds successive definitions of lying through ATLA cases: Aang's 'Bonzu Pippinpaddleopsicopolis' alias, non-linguistic disguises versus Toph's 'I'm blind!' mere misleading, brainwashed Jet whose false statements are not lies ('Lake Laogai'), and Azula's battleship metaphor ('The Beach'), arriving at Carson's warranting contexts to count the Dai Li's 'There is no war in Ba Sing Se' and Azula's '400-foot-tall purple platypus bear' as Sorensen's bald-faced lies told without intent to deceive. Frankfurt's bullshit explains Aunt Wu's fortunetelling, and the conclusion is political: bald-faced lies corrode the trust on which communities rest, so we must refuse to live in a real-world Ba Sing Se.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 141 - Avatar_ The Last Airbender and Philosophy - Wisdom from Aang to Zuko
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Trust and Truth
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Kellen builds successive definitions of lying from ATLA cases: Aang's invented Jin Wei and Wei Jin story in 'The Great Divide' is a plain lie, Toph's 'How could I possibly play? I'm blind!' merely misleads, brainwashed Jet's false statements are no lie because he believes them, and Azula's '400-foot-tall purple platypus bear' breaks the intent-to-deceive requirement. That prepares the diagnosis of Ba Sing Se: the pet-shop owner's 'That would be illegal' and the 'There is no war in Ba Sing Se' mantra are Sorensen's bald-faced lies, undisguised and not meant to deceive, countable as lies only via Carson's warranting contexts. Aunt Wu's fortunes illustrate Frankfurtian bullshit, indifference to truth, and the chapter closes on how such lies corrode the trust communities are built on.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 147 - Bioshock and Philosophy - Irrational Game, Rational Book
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Noble Lies, Noble Propaganda
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: McKinnon distinguishes lying (asserting what you believe false) from Frankfurtian bullshit (indifference to truth) and argues Andrew Ryan's propaganda, from 'Is a man not entitled to the sweat of his brow?' to the smuggler scare, is closer to bullshit than lying: it aims at controlling citizens' behavior, not at fooling them about facts. Frankfurt's warning that habitual bullshitters lose the ability to discern truth is borne out by Ryan's own audio diary ('have I become so convinced by my own beliefs that I have stopped seeing the truth?'). Yet the chapter defends 'noble' warranted assertions: Ryan's nostalgia lie to Jack about family and friends is told so Jack will discover the truth of what he is, showing that some propaganda aimed at the hearer's truth is not morally problematic.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 152 - The Ultimate Daily Show and Philosophy - More Moments of Zen, More Indecision Theory
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Ultimate Daily Show and Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Blessing and Marren mine Stewart's two interviews with Harry Frankfurt to work out the lie/bullshit distinction: liars like Edwards, Weiner and Clinton know and care about the truth they distort, while bullshitters, from Travelodge PR stunts to subprime lenders, are indifferent to truth in service of selling, which is why Frankfurt calls bullshit the more corrosive force. They take up Stewart's Socratic questioning of whether political spin is a subset of bullshit, and answer that spinners, unlike bullshitters, must know the truth in order to color it, making spin closer to lying in attitude, tolerated because Spin Alley agrees not to call bullshit on it. Documenting the PR-ization of media (the Cardiff University study behind Flat Earth News, the Wall Street Journal press-release finding), they close with Frankfurt's On Truth sequel, that a society cannot survive without truth, with ridicule of the kind The Daily Show practices as the best defense.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 152 - The Ultimate Daily Show and Philosophy - More Moments of Zen, More Indecision Theory
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Ultimate Daily Show and Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Torosyan argues The Daily Show models the critical thinking and good-faith civic discourse that real politics and TV news lack, reading John Oliver's 'Civil Disservice' interview with Froma Harrop and Stewart's clips of Rumsfeld contradicting himself on WMDs as exposing bullshit in Frankfurt's sense: assertion indifferent to truth. Stewart's reframing of William Bennett's gay-marriage talking points (is the debate about marriage or about who counts as human?) and his self-effacing interviews with Ramesh Ponnuru enact Rousseau's social-contract ideal of what news owes the public against Machiavellian ends-justify-means manipulation. Gadamer supplies the demand that Bennett question his own horizons, Nietzsche's Apollonian-Dionysian account of tragedy frames the show's satire, and the Tao Te Ching's 'let yourself be partial' governs the whole chapter.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 185 - Saturday Night Live and Philosophy - Deep Thoughts Through the Decades
frankfurt-bullshit.title: And in the End
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Irwin and addictions specialist Lombardo ask where comic inspiration comes from, using Socrates' discovery that poets do not know the meaning of their own work, Hume's account of creativity as recombining materials of experience, and Nietzsche's point that inspiration is really continuous production sifted by judgment, to explain why Belushi and Farley treated cocaine and alcohol as muses. They contrast Belushi's fatal 'I use drugs' hubris, which no one around him challenged, with Farley's genuine twelve-step recovery, three sober years, and relapses. Stuart Smalley's affirmations, which bullshit himself into feeling 'good enough,' spoof recovery culture's cliches while Farley's story shows what actual recovery demands, ending with the advice to look elsewhere for the muse.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 192 - Superman and Philosophy - What Would the Man of Steel Do_
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 18. Superman the Super Dick
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Borrowing Harry Frankfurt's move of philosophically defining a colloquial term (as Frankfurt did for 'bullshit'), it defines a 'dick' as someone who willfully disregards others' needs and argues Superman is one: the vending-machine thought experiment shows he could rescue a sinking school bus in less time than it takes Clark to buy a chocolate bar, so saving people at little or no cost to himself is obligatory, not supererogatory. Peter Singer's famine-and-affluence argument extends the same obligation to the affluent reader, while the SuperBat arc of Superman/Batman #53–56—in which Batman temporarily gains Superman's powers and empties every city's jails in one night—proves Superman could do vastly more than he does. Batman, who risks his mortal life and seeks out strangers to save, is 'not a dick' and wins the round.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 195 - Ted Lasso and Philosophy - No Question Is Into Touch
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Notes
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Husmann and Kusko apply Frankfurt's On Bullshit distinction - the liar cares about truth while the bullshitter is indifferent to it - to argue Ted Lasso combats BS through correctness (accurately representing a shared world) before sincerity. Ted never fakes tactical knowledge and accepts hard truths like his divorce; the good guys (Sam's protest, Roy refusing a fake-injury ruse, Trent's fair profile) reject BS; Rupert is the show's virtuoso BS artist from the charity gala interruption to crashing the funeral; and Rebecca, Jamie, and Nate's arcs are measured as their movements up and down the BS spectrum.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 226 - The Philosophy of Michael Mann
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Philosophy of Michael Mann
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Corne unpacks Vincent Hanna's tirade in Heat against his wife's ex-husband's 'dead-tech, postmodernistic, bullshit house.' He reads the smashing of the television and the headless sculpture through Bataille's Against Architecture (buildings as latent prisons of authority) and Jameson's diagnosis of postmodern depthlessness and the silence of affect. Using Hegel, Hugo and Ruskin on architecture's obligation to tell the truth, and especially Frankfurt's On Bullshit, Corne argues the house is 'bullshit' because it is indifferent to truth; Vincent's workaholism becomes a Frankfurtian discipline, and the film reflexively treats truth, authenticity and space as a problem.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 252 - Better Call Saul and Philosophy - I Think Therefore I Scam
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 15. Saul’s Bullshit’s Not All Good, Man
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Applying Harry Frankfurt's account of bullshit as speech that lacks proper concern for truth, the chapter reads Jimmy's reinstatement-hearing speech about Chuck as pure bullshit: every word he says is true, yet he says it only to win the panel over, as his 'Did you see those suckers?' aside reveals. It then argues Jimmy and Saul's bullshit is harmful on three fronts: it undermines the epistemic demands we owe to what we care about (Kim's ability to know Jimmy's real state), it corrupts the epistemic duties tied to social roles (the panelists as quasi-jurors), and it erodes general epistemic trust across society.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 260 - The Daily Show and Philosophy - Moments of Zen in the Art of Fake News
frankfurt-bullshit.title: The Ultimate Daily Show and Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Kimberly Blessing and Joseph Marren build on Harry Frankfurt's two Daily Show appearances and On Bullshit to distinguish the liar (who respects and knows the truth) from the bullshitter (who is indifferent to it), then take up Stewart's own question of whether political spin is a subset of bullshit. Against Frankfurt they argue spin is closer to lying—spinners must know the truth to slant its significance—and trace the 'PR-ization of media' (Nick Davies's data, Travelodge, subprime lending) that fuels it, endorsing Frankfurt's and Stewart's remedy: ridicule bullshit and spin through satire because truth matters.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 262 - Dr. Seuss and Philosophy - Oh, the Thinks You Can Think!
frankfurt-bullshit.title: Socratic Seuss Intellectual Integrity and Truth-Orientation
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: Matthew Pierlott casts Seuss as a Socratic gadfly for intellectual integrity, built on Frankfurt's distinction between the liar (who respects truth) and the bullshitter (who is indifferent to it). Sam-I-Am's reluctant friend in Green Eggs and Ham is 'bullshitting' to be left alone; the boasting rabbit and bear of 'The Big Brag' are humbled by a worm who plays Socrates as in Plato's Euthyphro; Horton Hatches the Egg and Mulberry Street show self-delusion (believing what we wish were true); and 'What Was I Scared Of?' shows fear distorting the interpretation of evidence, all mapped against Pierlott's five aspects of intellectual integrity.

frankfurt-bullshit.book: 308 - The Palgrave Handbook of Popular Culture as Philosophy
frankfurt-bullshit.title: 58. Tom Sawyer as Philosopher Lying and Deception on the Mississippi
frankfurt-bullshit.relation: The chapter treats Mark Twain's Tom Sawyer novels as applied epistemology, arguing lying is far broader and more varied than spoken falsehood. Using Augustine's intent-to-deceive definition it analyzes Tom whitewashing the fence, the blood oath about Injun Joe's murder, Huck's 'sacrifice lie' about smallpox, and disguises as 'showing the false' (mimicking, inventing, decoying) versus 'hiding the truth' (masking, repackaging, dazzling). It invokes Gettier's method of counterexamples as a parallel to Twain showing the traditional definition of lying is too narrow, and links Tom's gaslighting of Aunt Sally and evolutionary/self-deception to modern fake news and deepfakes.

levinas-face.book: 020 - Poker and Philosophy - Pocket Rockets and Philosopher Kings
levinas-face.title: Poker and Philosophy
levinas-face.relation: Lindholm retells Stu Ungar's 1981 WSOP repeat — the 'Jews' (Ungar, Perry Green, Jay Heimowitz) against the 'Texans' (Ken Smith, Gene Fisher, Bill Smith) — through Levinas's Talmudic lecture 'The Temptation of Temptation.' Philosophy's sin is wanting to know before doing, while the Jews at Sinai accepted the Torah before knowing what it contained; the gambler's decision under risk, like Ungar's triple all-ins and final A-Q call against Green, enacts the same ethical priority of doing over knowing, so to lose is still to win if you dared to decide. Ethics as first philosophy — responsibility to the Other prior to comprehension, born of Levinas's Holocaust losses — closes the loop: unlike poker, life is not zero-sum, and deciding to decide lets everyone win.

levinas-face.book: 028 - The Grateful Dead and Philosophy - Getting High Minded about Love and Haight
levinas-face.title: I’ve Got Time to Hear His Story
levinas-face.relation: Stephen Stern reads the 'Wharf Rat' narrator's decision to give August West not a dime but time to hear his story as an enactment of Levinas's ethics: hearing the other's call ipso facto obligates us, and listening restores the face that the label 'wharf rat' stripped away, just as Levinas was stripped of his 'human skin' as vermin in a Nazi POW camp. He parallels West's hope that the absent Pearly Baker 'been true to me' with Levinas's hope in his absent wife and daughter, locating traces of God not in a friendly maker but in human commitment and responsibility for the other. The chapter closes on the narrator walking downtown to his own Bonny Lee, suggesting that responding to August West liberates both parties from isolation.

levinas-face.book: 034 - iPod and Philosophy - iCon of an ePoch
levinas-face.title: The Verdict
levinas-face.relation: Turner runs an ethical audit of iPod use through Levinas's face-to-face: sharing one iPod with his wife forces 'musical justice' negotiations (veto power over a Motörhead cut, gnashing through Bette Midler), his toddler son's listening requires vigilance, and illegal downloading fails Levinas's test that morality begins by ceding 'my place in the sun' to the Other — hence Radiohead's pay-what-you-want release as the Levinasian move, and iPod cafés where strangers DJ for each other while language preserves alterity. Heidegger supplies the counterweight: the shuffle's 'openness to mystery' versus calculative mastery that reduces The Who's Tommy to the 'Pinball Wizard' riff and silences all non-digital media, just as Kant's conditions of possible experience (space, time) would silence things outside them. Derrida's point that categories contain traces of what they exclude illuminates unclassifiable marginal works — bluegrass Pink Floyd, San Francisco Symphony plays Metallica — and the verdict closes with Hölderlin's 'where danger is, grows the saving power also', exiting Plato's cave by thinking the iPod's ethics at all.

levinas-face.book: 053 - Martial Arts and Philosophy - Beating and Nothingness
levinas-face.title: Back at the Bins, or Loving Your Enemy Like Your Neighbor
levinas-face.relation: Kohn begins with her own response to a serial bin-tipper: practicing iaido sword draws in full view of the neighbours to intimidate an imagined Other. Contrasting iaido's virtual opponent (a mere tool for the self) with aikido's real partners, she deploys Levinas's face of the Other, responsibility without waiting for reciprocity and philosophy as 'the Wisdom of Love', alongside Arendt's shared responsibility for the world's conflicts, to argue that care for even one's attacker comes first, with Kant's categorical imperative as the generalizable counterpart to Levinas's ethics. Her confession: she treated the imagined culprit as an object of hate, when meeting 'the Face' would have demanded an apology and maybe a hug.

levinas-face.book: 063 - Philip K. Dick and Philosophy - Do Androids Have Kindred Spirits
levinas-face.title: He Ain’t Heavy, He’s My Other
levinas-face.relation: This section stages Levinas's infinite responsibility for the Other against Heidegger's tendency to treat others as tools for warding off death: J.R. Isidore's one-way care for androids who vivisect a spider, Dick's 'The Android and the Human' warning that androidization means becoming predictable means, and the treatment of animals as the litmus test of humanity. The self becomes real through selfless action (Tagomi saving a stranger, Sweetscent returning to his wife), and because the height separating self and Other descends from Descartes's idea of infinity, meeting the face of the poor stranger, from Radio Free Albemuth's beggar to The Adjustment Bureau's Chairman, is an encounter with God.

levinas-face.book: 063 - Philip K. Dick and Philosophy - Do Androids Have Kindred Spirits
levinas-face.title: Fifty Ways to Love Your Other
levinas-face.relation: The section reads Levinas's demand to experience the Other's suffering in the Other's place as Dick's empathy made literal: the shifting points of view that blur heroes and villains, Felix Buckman's tears, Molinari developing his people's symptoms, and the empathy boxes bonding users to Mercer's endless stoning, a fraud whose falsity is beside the point because the concern is the real thing. Villains are precisely those who refuse the transfer, and the ordinary one-way gift, buying a stranger a drink with no return, enacts the Golden Rule: even if the universe isn't real, Melina is right, kiss each other anyway.

levinas-face.book: 080 - Ender's Game and Philosophy - Genocide Is Child's Play
levinas-face.title: Ender’s Game and Philosophy
levinas-face.relation: Brett Patterson reads Card's philotes and the ansible as an uncanny parallel to Leibniz's Monadology - simple, internally varied, interconnected building blocks whose 'twining' explains instantaneous communication - and reads Ender's bond with the hive-queen through Levinas, for whom the face-to-face encounter with the Other imposes responsibility prior to self-understanding. That bond, formed through the Giant's Drink landscape the buggers built from Ender's own dreams, is why he cannot go home: he becomes Speaker for the Dead to restore the species he destroyed.

levinas-face.book: 107 - Deadpool and Philosophy - My Common Sense Is Tingling
levinas-face.title: 16. The Beautiful Face Behind the Mask
levinas-face.relation: Reading Deadpool through Levinas's Totality and Infinity, the chapter treats his mask and nonstop jokes as the closed totality of an isolated 'I,' and his face-to-face encounters - Siryn touching his scarred head, Vanessa and Mercedes seeing and accepting his face, the dead-shark dialogue, the North Korean clones who share his DNA - as the epiphany of the other that grounds ethics. Levinas's account of murder as denying the other's face explains why Theresa (Siryn) stops Wade from executing Dr. Killebrew, the Weapon X torturer whose eyes showed he regarded Wade as meat. The chapter concludes that Deadpool's face is beautiful as the expression of his inner self, and that living for others rather than for his own (impossible) death is the ethical path he keeps glimpsing.

levinas-face.book: 121 - The Twilight Zone and Philosophy - A Dangerous Dimension to Visit
levinas-face.title: 4. Faces from Another Dimension
levinas-face.relation: Hooke frames the volume through Levinas's claim that the face presents itself from a dimension of transcendence, with Kierkegaard's Abraham, Sartre's existential look, and Beauvoir's faces of the elderly and the second sex in the background, plus Lingis on trust. He shows how TZ masks its deadliest figures with trusted faces — Robert Redford as Death in 'Nothing in the Dark,' Sebastian Cabot's avuncular Pip revealing 'This is the other place!' in 'A Nice Place to Visit,' the witch of 'Jess-Belle,' the gentle Kanamits whose book turns out to be a cookbook — so that proof of trust is nearly impossible and the show has us laughing with the Devil. The Turing test is applied to Alicia's tear in 'The Lonely' (clearly in love 'regardless of the organs or hardware beneath'), the slot machine of 'The Fever,' and the aged couple of 'The Trade-Ins,' whose faces silently recognize a lost shared life.

levinas-face.book: 123 - The Handmaid's Tale and Philosophy - A Womb of One's Own
levinas-face.title: 12. Gilead as Palimpsest
levinas-face.relation: Ketcham likens Offred's existence to holocaust by degree: her name is overwritten as the Nazis tattooed forearms, and her past survives like ink bleeding through a palimpsest. Using Derrida's sous rature (via Spivak's introduction and Heidegger's crossed-out words)—the word crossed out yet necessary—he reads her memories as 'under erasure,' and through Levinas's 'useless suffering' shows how her cocooned passivity severs her from the responsibility-for-the-other in which Levinas locates freedom, which is exactly what the he-theonomy needs to rule. With Du Bois's double consciousness and the Hitler parallel, the chapter warns that ideologues promising to cure suffering—Hitler, the Sons of Jacob—only write a new, more oppressive text over the erased old one.

levinas-face.book: 130 - The Good Place and Philosophy - Get an Afterlife
levinas-face.title: 18. Heaven Is Other People
levinas-face.relation: Mayward examines the show's eschatology, arguing its points algorithm critiques the popular picture of Hell as eternal conscious torment, in the lineage of Jonathan Edwards, while missing historic Christian teaching about embodied resurrection. He then reads the series through Levinas, for whom ethics arises in the face-to-face encounter with the Other prior to any impersonal judgment, a structure mirrored in the show's two-shots and in Eleanor's spontaneous good deeds done before she understands them, and through Dietrich Bonhoeffer's 'religionless Christianity', in which Michael's self-sacrifice and the humans' repentance enact responsibility for neighbors without hope of reward. Salvation in the show is intersubjective transformation: where Sartre said Hell is other people, The Good Place suggests Heaven is other people.

levinas-face.book: 131 - Avengers Infinity Saga and Philosophy - Go for the Head
levinas-face.title: 2. What Does Life Mean after the Snap
levinas-face.relation: This chapter reads four post-Snap Avengers as existentialist answers to how life keeps meaning after catastrophe. Tony Stark embodies Sartre's existence precedes essence, defining himself through free choice up to his final 'I am Iron Man' snap that erases Thanos and his army; the merged Professor Hulk lives Camus's Sisyphus, embracing the absurd and concluding 'all is well' after watching his own past rage; Captain America lives Levinas's ethics of the Other, from refusing to abandon brainwashed Bucky in Civil War to wielding Mjolnir to save Thor; and Ronin-era Hawkeye enacts Nietzschean nihilism until Black Widow's Vormir sacrifice, read through Zarathustra's burning in one's own flame, restores his meaning. The authors conclude Marvel's answer is affirmation: courage to affirm freedom, the Other, and life itself against Thanos as personification of genocide, climate change, and war.

levinas-face.book: 133 - Perry Mason and Philosophy - The Case of the Awesome Attorney
levinas-face.title: 16. Justice The Master Narrative
